answer.book: Corpus theologiae christianae, tomus prior (Tigurum 1700) by Johann Heinrich Heidegger: a systematic dogmatics in loci, each with a breviarium and numbered theses, preceded by a dedication and a general index that covers all 28 loci. This volume ends at Locus XVI (FINIS TOMI PRIORIS). The chapters listed in the index (I., II. ... with thesis ranges) are not headed in the body, so they are not entries.
